adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, when no TopicEmbed exists it always enqueues `:retrieve_topic` and renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The loading view unconditionally reloads every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb). In the job path, `TopicRetriever#retrieve` can permanently no-op (e.g., `invalid_host?` true, or `fetch_http` returns early when `embed_by_username` user is missing) and there is no mechanism in the controller/view to detect/report that failure. This yields an indefinite reload loop on permanent misconfig/error, matching the finding.
